title: Eternal IoT — ESP32 Smart Lock NFC & Sensor (Homelab)

options.content:
### 🔐 Eternal — ESP32 Smart Lock NFC & Sensor DHT11
**Perangkat:** `ETL-ESP32-001` · FW `3.1.0` · IP `192.168.25.104`  |  **Mode kunci:** Tap NFC 1× = BUKA (ON) · Tap lagi = KUNCI (OFF) · Auto-Lock **2 jam**  |  **Alur data:** ESP32 → Mosquitto MQTT → PAP Core API `:8000` → InfluxDB `:8086` / MySQL `eternal_db` → Grafana

panels.title: 🔐 Status Kunci
panels.description: Status solenoid/relay terakhir dari ESP32 (is_locked: 0 = terbuka, 1 = terkunci).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eternal_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serial"] == "${serial}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "is_locked")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: 🪪 Tap NFC Terakhir
panels.description: Pengguna kartu NFC yang terakhir tap (dari tabel nfc_access_logs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(nama, ' (', uid, ')') AS 'Pengguna' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF','NFC_DENIED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 📡 Koneksi ESP32
panels.description: ONLINE bila ada data masuk ke InfluxDB dalam 90 detik terakhir.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eternal_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)

from(bucket: "eternal_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serial"] == "${serial}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "temperature" or r["_field"] == "humidity")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0.0)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_measurement", "_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value:
        if r.temperature < 22.0 then "Sejuk"
        else if r.temperature <= 28.5 and r.humidity >= 35.0 and r.humidity <= 70.0 then "Nyaman Ideal"
        else if r.temperature <= 32.0 then "Hangat"
        else "Panas"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: 🧠 Free Heap ESP32
panels.description: Memori bebas terendah per interval. Turun terus-menerus = indikasi memory leak.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eternal_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serial"] == "${serial}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "free_heap")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Free Heap (byte)"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Free Heap (byte)"])

panels.title: ✅ Akses Berhasil (rentang waktu)
panels.description: Jumlah tap yang membuka/mengunci pada rentang waktu dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Akses Berhasil' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF');

panels.title: ⛔ Akses Ditolak (rentang waktu)
panels.description: Kartu tidak terdaftar yang mencoba akses. Banyak penolakan = periksa keamanan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Ditolak' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type = 'NFC_DENIED';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Kartu Aktif' FROM nfc_users WHERE is_active = 1;
SELECT MAX(created_at) AS 'Tap Terakhir' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF','NFC_DENIED');

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, 1h), SUM(action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF')) AS 'Berhasil', SUM(action_type = 'NFC_DENIED') AS 'Ditolak' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT nama AS 'Pengguna', COUNT(*) AS 'Tap' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF') GROUP BY nama ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT uid AS 'UID', nama AS 'Nama', username AS 'Username', role AS 'Role', CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN '✅ AKTIF' ELSE '⛔ NONAKTIF' END AS 'Status', total_taps AS 'Total Tap', COALESCE(last_login_at, '-') AS 'Tap Terakhir' FROM nfc_users ORDER BY id ASC;

SELECT created_at AS 'Waktu', uid AS 'UID', nama AS 'Nama', role AS 'Role', CASE action_type
    WHEN 'NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK'    THEN '🔓 Buka Kunci (Tap ON)'
    WHEN 'TAP_ON'               THEN '🔓 Buka Kunci (Tap ON)'
    WHEN 'NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK'  THEN '🔓 Buka Kunci (Daftar Kartu)'
    WHEN 'NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK'     THEN '🔒 Kunci (Tap OFF)'
    WHEN 'TAP_OFF'              THEN '🔒 Kunci (Tap OFF)'
    WHEN 'AUTO_LOCK_2H'         THEN '⏲️ Auto-Lock 2 Jam'
    WHEN 'NFC_DENIED'           THEN '⛔ Ditolak (Kartu Tidak Terdaftar)'
    WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_UNLOCK'   THEN '🌐 Remote Buka (MQTT)'
    WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_LOCK'     THEN '🌐 Remote Kunci (MQTT)'
    WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_TOGGLE_ON'  THEN '🌐 Remote Buka (MQTT)'
    WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_TOGGLE_OFF' THEN '🌐 Remote Kunci (MQTT)'
    ELSE action_type END AS 'Aksi', lock_duration_sec AS 'Durasi (s)', device_ip AS 'IP ESP32' FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type <> 'REGISTER_USER' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: 🔄 Sinkron MySQL (iot_devices)
panels.description: Apakah snapshot perangkat di MySQL eternal_db diperbarui dalam 2 menit terakhir.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN updated_at IS NULL THEN 'BELUM ADA DATA' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, updated_at, NOW()) <= 120 THEN 'TERSINKRON' ELSE 'TERTINGGAL' END AS 'Sinkron' FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '${serial}' LIMIT 1;

SELECT device_serial AS 'Serial', device_name AS 'Nama', model AS 'Model', ip_address AS 'IP', mac_address AS 'MAC', ssid AS 'SSID', firmware_version AS 'Firmware', wifi_rssi AS 'RSSI (dBm)', status AS 'Status', last_seen_at AS 'Terakhir Terlihat' FROM iot_devices ORDER BY device_serial;
